new_leads: AS-2 mirror (a third block): when the reply to the SECOND F1 block is not yet in the record, feedback() counts only the first block, so the gate blocks a third time, past 'twice at most'. Case A2c in WORK/verify-fa-stop/mine.py: two blocked stops in the record, stop_hook_active=True, the reply only in last_assistant_message -> got=block:F1, want=allow.

Helper-ledger edge: Model.outward compares a note's time with the timestamp of the row AFTER the stretch start. A note stamped between the owner's message row and the next row therefore falls outside the new stretch (mine.py case A3b -> allow). The previous stretch was already judged, so such a helper commit is never counted.

AS-1 reaches other counted calls too: a PR create/update through MCP whose result echoes a title or body holding 'requires approval' or 'TURN-GATE' in its first 600 characters would be dropped the same way (not run).
